description: Defines data structures, classes, and interfaces related to MAC layer results and scheduling in a 5G NR context, including SSB, PDU, and scheduler result representations.

classes.name: mac_cell_result_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying MAC cell results, including downlink and uplink scheduling results and completion notifications.

classes.name: mac_result_notifier
classes.description: Interface for obtaining cell-specific result notifiers based on cell index.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Notify about new downlink scheduler results.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_data
methods.description: Notify about new downlink data PDUs.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Notify about new uplink scheduler results.

methods.name: on_cell_results_completion
methods.description: Notify completion of all cell results for a given slot.

methods.name: get_cell
methods.description: Retrieve the cell result notifier for a specific cell index.
